name: Sitewise 3D lighting rig
note: Mirrors applyLighting() in mark.js. Values are physical; if you change one, re-check that no face clips at 255 and that each face still carries a tonal spread.
principle: Directional and hemisphere light both deliver constant irradiance across a flat face, so no amount of either can stop a plane reading as one flat tone. The key must be a point or spot source with distance falloff. Directionals are fill only.

renderer.note: A physically-lit scene of this brightness clips without tone mapping — the bone floor goes flat white at 255.

lights.role: second caster so junctions read twice
THE KEY. Just outside the open corner; falloff varies across every plane.
picks out wall and floor interiors

occlusion.axis: deepest at the glazing/wall edge (x=+0.5, z=−0.5), most open at the missing corner (x=−0.5, z=+0.5)
occlusion.note: Modulates diffuse albedo only. Keep metalness and envMapIntensity low or the specular term swamps the ramp.

measuredResult.view: logo lock (fov 9, camera on the 1,1,1 axis)
measuredResult.note: Before the point key, the roof moved four levels across its whole diagonal. Use these figures as the regression test.

ground.note: The model's lowest point IS the bone floor, so a stage ground plane resting on the bounding box z-fights with it. Hide it, or drop it clear by at least 0.006.
